THREE BOOKS THAT NAME CAMP KANAWANA IN PASSING. All three are lending-restricted on the Internet
Archive and CANNOT be read from here. Each passage was assembled 2026-09-06 from overlapping
Open Library search-inside windows. RECONSTRUCTIONS, not transcriptions; nothing outside the
quoted stretch has been read.

================================================================================
1. "Les Laurentides, peintures et paysage : exposition itinérante" (1977)
   Internet Archive item leslaurentidespe0000unse, scan leaf 106.
   An art-exhibition catalogue.

QUERIES: "Camp Kanawana" ; "comme le camp Kanawana de la YMCA sont venus dormir" ;
         "sont venus dormir sous la tente" ; "et s'aventurer dans des sorties" ;
         "chasse, les garçons installés" ; "dans des colonies de vacances comme le" ;
         "Mais pour découvrir" Kanawana

RECONSTRUCTED:

  ... sont venus à la pêche et à la chasse, les garçons installés dans des colonies de vacances
  comme le camp Kanawana de la YMCA sont venus dormir sous la tente et s'aventurer dans des
  sorties en canoë. Mais pour découvrir cette région, les peintres des Laurentides ...

WHAT IT IS: a catalogue essay listing the ways outsiders came to know the Laurentians -- anglers,
hunters, and boys at summer camps -- with Kanawana as the named example of the third. Who wrote
it, and what precedes and follows, were not recovered.

================================================================================
2. Mike Gutwillig, "My Canada -- Such a Mechiah!" (Prize Books, 1967)
   Internet Archive item mycanadasuchmech0000mike, scan leaf 168.

QUERIES: "Camp Kanawana" ; "getting Camp Kanawana or Tameracouta"

RECONSTRUCTED (the OCR carries stray characters, marked):

  ... (and, if you were really fortunate, getting [=] Camp Kanawana or Tameracouta for two
  weeks); t[?] the gods, the ...

WHAT IT IS: a Montreal memoir naming Kanawana and Tamaracouta -- the Scout camp -- as the two
prize summer destinations of a childhood. The sentence around it was not recovered and the
speaker's period is not established from this window.

================================================================================
3. L. Ian MacDonald, "Politics, People & Potpourri"
   (Montreal: published for The Gazette by McGill-Queen's University Press, 2009)
   Internet Archive item politicspeoplepo0000macd, scan leaf 354.

QUERIES: "Camp Kanawana" ; "five-day canoe trip at Camp Kanawana" ;
         "in the Lauren" "tians, she is the" ; "family expert on proper canoeing technique"

RECONSTRUCTED:

  ... Because she recently went on a five-day canoe trip at Camp Kanawana in the Lauren[-]tians,
  she is the family expert on proper canoeing technique and has con[-]cluded I'm quite ...

WHAT IT IS: a Gazette columnist's aside about a family member's Kanawana canoe trip, collected in
book form in 2009. She is not named in the recovered window and is not named here. The column's
own date was not recovered; the collection runs to 2009.
